newsitem.title: UK: European bunker fuel prices stay easy in relaxed demand.
newsitem.headline: European bunker fuel prices stay easy in relaxed demand.

text.p: European bunker fuel prices stayed easy on Wednesday. Traders said weaker spot and futures, crude and gas oil markets caused some retracement of small gains made on Tuesday after a pick up in demand in ex-wharf.
Again diesel and gas oil bunkers were the biggest losers as gas oil futures continued to slide and physical markets weakened on expectation of additional supplies from the United States.

High sulphur fuel oil bunkers shed around $2 a tonne to trade down at $118 a tonne in ARA as competition for business strengthened. Brokers said moderate but fairly relaxed demand was outweighed by good avails in most ports.
Rotterdam and Antwerp bunker bunkers were talked at parity with the Rotterdam market easing under some selling pressure while Antwerp drifted lower in quiet trade.
Hamburg continued to hold a wide $6 per tonne premium to the ARA market although trade remained thin as did demand into Le Havre and Falmouth.

Mediterranean markets too were easy although fuel oil bunkers at Spanish and French Med ports were better supported with brokers reporting good demand. 380 cst bunkers in Algeciras valued around $125 ex-wharf with Fos around $122.50 a tonne.
